== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Chasm (V)]] (<code>1200_7o</code>, Virtual Shields), showing the '''Original''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VSh-L-chasm-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1200-7-shield-master.png]]) show the later errata text of [[Chasm (V) (Errata)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VShieldsType, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064820/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VShieldsType.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121213024746/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VShieldsType.html 2012-12-13], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130212003929/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VShieldsType.html 2013-02-12], Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. The first release sheet that printed this shield has not been found; this is the earliest known text. No errata mark (the original).
* '''Original text:''' “Plays on table. Substituted battle destinies do not count against battle destiny limits. If all your battle destinies were canceled (and not redrawn) your total battle destiny = 1. Once per game, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1200_7o</code>: Decipher art, Defensive Shield frame, title, lore, Virtual Shields set mark, original-title strip, copyright line) with the Original game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. The expansion icon was replaced with the one on the Players Committee card image.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
